audit_items.proof_trace: ADL and normal liquidation use distinct permission constants: `whitelist_admin::liquidation()` returns 2 (bit 2) and `whitelist_admin::adl()` returns 3 (bit 3), enforced via a bitmask check in `ensure_has_permission`. All ADL entry points (`liquidate_adl_borrow`, `liquidate_adl_deposit`) unconditionally pass `whitelist_admin::adl()` to `pre_liquidation_check`, and the underlying market functions are `public(package)` with no other callers.
